entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-14
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • PlatformInformation.IsWindows/IsUnix checks can likely be replaced with RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform calls #86065
  • Nullable analysis doesn't detect a fact that collection builder for an expanded params collection argument can produce a null value #86064
  • Filtered generator runs can omit shared post-init sources and poison the compilation cache #86062
  • Parameter post-conditions are unexpectedly applied through a user defined conversion used by the argument #86057
    18.13
  • Nullable analysis around union construction ignores the fact that params array is never null #86055
    18.13
  • [Known Build Error] InvalidGotoLiftingBetweenGotoAndLabel4 fails with NullReferenceException #86052
  • [Known Build Error] TestMultiFile_EditTransitiveDirective fails with ArgumentException: Type provided must be an Enum #86051
  • [Known Build Error] UseExistingServerConcurrently fails with Client disconnected RejectedBuildResponse #86050
  • EnC: adding an async lambda that awaits a `dynamic` call throws InvalidOperationException in DeltaMetadataWriter.GetFieldDefinitionHandle #86045

Closed

  • Invalid IDE0059 When using constant inside static local function #44948
    Backlog
  • 'Use pattern-matching' should be missing on writes from local function captures #29512
    Backlog
  • Regression in SDK 10.0.400+: ParentTag TagHelpers not resolving for self-closing <img /> and <source /> elements #86053
  • EmitFieldLoad possibly uses over-optimistic optimization for scenario when field's value isn't used #84563
    Backlog
  • Find All References does not find cross project references to partial properties in Web projects #82744
  • Roslyn fails to process user defined conversions for union constructor arguments nullability analysis #85978
    18.13
  • Go to definition not working for XAML classes in definition #85872
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-12313.121 #86054
  • Razor formatter inserts repeated indentation in multiline ternary and @foreach blocks #85661
    Backlog
  • Razor formatting errors when attributes span multiple lines #86027
    18.13

PullRequests

Created

  • Simplify RunTests Windows process discovery and log dump stages #86068
  • [WIP] Fix thin-client shutdown exit code in daemon server tests #86067
  • Set union values state as not-null when constructor invocation uses expanded form #86063
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Scope compiler server mutexes per-user #86056
    Area-Compilers
  • Restore metadata and analyzer references for cached projects #86049
    VSCode
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3105797 #86046
    Area-Razor

Merged

  • Allow LSP used in copilot to report telemetry #86066
    VSCode, Next
  • Don't track const locals in unused value analysis #85994
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode, Next
  • Don't offer 'use pattern matching' when a local function writes the 'as' operand #85991
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode, Next
  • Introduce a Razor DLL for `dotnet format`, and share formatting code #85963
    Area-Razor, Next
  • Ensure unused BoundPassByCopy access evaluates all observable side effects #85986
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • [release/dev18.0] Backport goto lifting test workaround #86058
  • Fix Find References for partial members seen through a retargeting assembly #85844
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode, Next
  • Infer union nullability from converted state of constructor's argument #86031
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions, Next
  • Fix Go to Definition for XAML classes #86041
    VSCode, Next
  • [release/dev18.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #86048
  • Don't copy generated file banners to new documents #85682
    Area-Razor, Next
  • [Add options to] skip formatting in script and style blocks with complex Razor expressions #85142
    Area-Razor, Next
  • Fix Razor multiline attribute directive formatting #86028
    Area-Razor, Next
  • Add RoslynTools init scripts #86036
    Next

Updated

  • Enforce BOM configuration in CI #85810
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Create a skill for analyzing memory dumps #86035
  • Fix DiagnosticDescription formatting for integer codes and stabilize TestMultiFile_EditTransitiveDirective #86029
    VSCode
  • Migrate C# and Visual Basic options to Unified Settings #86026
    VSCode
  • [release/insiders] Fix analyzer collision in bootstrap leg #85987
    VSCode
  • Reduce accessibility for synthesized static local functions #86044
    Community
  • Fix Generate Constructor crash when inspecting properties in referenced projects #86021
    VSCode
  • Fix symbol-completion publication races #85972
  • Implement OnDemand Project Loading #85805
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Handle stackalloc syntax in RemoveUnusedMembers analysis #86016
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Add AI-assisted issue reproduction via label #86022
  • Onboard build failure analysis workflow #85046
    Area-Infrastructure, Community
  • Fix compilation caching across filtered generator runs #85935
    Area-Compilers, Community, Feature - Source Generators, VSCode
  • [release/dev17.14] Fix MSBuildWorkspace DisposeAsync type-load failures #86040
  • Delete TEMP redirection #86038
  • Improve local language-server integration guidance #85778
    Community
  • RoslynTools: handle snap commits #85843
  • Keep tuple element names when nullable analysis re-infers a call with a tuple literal argument #85976
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Report a misplaced '}' when a type is closed before its members #86034
    Area-Compilers, Community, VSCode
